views.markdown:
Hides jailbreak files, dyld images, Sileo/Filza URL schemes, and Frida port probes **without** disabling tweak injection.

Works while other tweaks and Frida stay loaded. Do **not** turn on Dopamine Hide Jailbreak if you want injection.
- Remove huge logo from the Sileo package description
- Fix empty Enabled Applications page: load AltList as a real controller (`bundle`, `isController`, `overridePrincipalClass`)
- Actually fix Settings: PreferenceLoader reads items at the plist root, not nested inside entry. That error screen was an empty specifier list.

- Remove huge icon from the GitHub README
- Fix Settings pane: use PreferenceLoader’s PLCustomListController so the switches actually load
- Fix Settings error: do not load KnightyPrefs.bundle (no missing executable). Pane is a PreferenceLoader plist only.

- Stop Settings crash: no custom prefs binary (Linux arm64e ABI was killing Settings on A12/A13)
- Settings pane is stock PSListController + AltList
- Do not install hooks in Settings at all
- Knighty icon in Settings, Sileo, and the repo
- Fix Settings crash when opening Knighty (don’t load AltList on the main page; never hook Settings)

- Build arm64 and arm64e so Settings / A12+ can load the prefs bundle
- Fix publish so Sileo actually gets the new version

- Settings app pane (like Crane)
- Per-app enable list via AltList
- Toggles for filesystem, tweaks, URLs, Frida ports, debugger

- Package display name is Knighty (not Veil)
- Compile fix for Sileo skip path

- Do not hook Sileo / apt / Filza / Dopamine (this was breaking Sileo)
- Guard ObjC hooks so they stay off in package managers

- Initial release for Dopamine 3 / iOS 18
- Filesystem, dyld, URL scheme, and Frida port hooks
